records.text: Vantage Partners still hasn't created a project a week in, flagging for outreach

records.subject: Checking in on Vantage Partners' setup
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Saw you brought a teammate in -- nice. How's it going so far for both of you?

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: No reply to either outreach (email:f360dfc9, email:be187f58), no tickets, and after 6 days still no first project despite 1 invite sent. Teammate invite shows some intent, but silence plus no project start in a Starter trial-stage account makes unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Vantage Partners moving
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Following up on my last note — I know setup weeks get busy. You've already got a teammate invited, so the main thing left is a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get that first project set up around real work you and your teammate already have in flight.

Best,
Chidi
